captions.table1: Medical papers state most reproducibility practices more often than other papers; only linking claims to results is rarer. Practices stated in the full text, medical versus other papers, nine venue-years. Shares among papers with a known value; pooled difference is the Mantel-Haenszel risk difference over venue-years with a 95% paper bootstrap interval.
captions.table2: The gap in being decided disappears after adjusting for the strength of the first team; the gap in full verification needs claim cost as well. Reproduction outcomes of attempted ICML 2026 papers, medical minus other, unadjusted and adjusted (post hoc analyses, Notes 9-9 to 9-15).
captions.table3: What papers state agrees poorly with what reproducers obtained, except for weights. Agreement on the 222 attempted ICML 2026 frame papers; the last column pools them with the 300-paper extension sample.
captions.table4: The documentation differences hold among empirical papers; with unstated releases counted as none, only the open-data difference stays large. Medical minus other, Mantel-Haenszel over venue-years, points with 95% CI (post hoc, Note 9-22).
captions.tablea1: Full texts were nearly complete where open proceedings exist and missing most often at NeurIPS 2026. Papers in the frame and with a coded full text, by group and venue-year.
